issues: Original printed CXXXIIII begins as a wife's appearance question, but multiple substantive unnumbered sections include supposed temperament, dowry/wealth, moral character and fortune attributed to marriage before next printed chapter.
Old zodiac-sign names and sign portion glyphs for pulchritude, mediocrity, deformity have not all been professionally double-read; no executable sign category allowed.
Saturn affliction, combustion, Venus/Saturn conjunction, Jupiter-Venus-Moon aspects, and old/widowed spouse are separate targets and require all printed qualifiers.
Planetary 'well affected' versus 'ill affected' condition reverses the author's claims for Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus and Mercury; no unqualified planet-to-person mapping.
The author says Sun and Moon do not directly signify temperament only in the Conditions of Wife passage, not in other marriage predictions in same book.
The Venus-position aphorisms conflate legal marriage age with marital history, sexual conduct, fertility, class, alleged sorcery, poisoning and spouse character.
Historical accusations about infidelity, prostitution, dishonesty, poison, magic or dangerous persons must not be inferred from or applied to real individuals.
Historical infertility and childlessness assertions are not medical evidence or appropriate treatment advice.
Original spouse beauty/deformity language is discriminatory and does not establish any person's disability, appearance or social attractiveness.
Ptolemy, Leovitius, Pezelius, Schoenerus, Garceus and Origanus are attributed by Lilly; their original texts have not been independently collated for these rules.
Lilly explicitly says favorable benefics do not automatically mean an aristocratic spouse: outcome must be relative to natal social class and actual status baseline.
Strong malefics in seventh can still indicate spouse wealth according to the source, with alleged scandal or poor temperament; avoid binary malefic = poor.
Several seventh/sixth/twelfth/eighth house placements have inverse alternative rulership paths, not both required in one chart.
Saturn grief and Mars destruction/death old associations are historical hypotheses, not mortality or danger predictions; benefic aspects are explicit source exception.
No independently verifiable natal records, spouse body measurements, marital surveys, wealth documents, class changes or death dates were evaluated.
No frozen scoring weights, exact dignity/aspect orbs, clinical definitions, gender-neutral applicability or ethical target-validation protocol exists for this text.
The following printed CXXXV mutual love and concord begins lower PDF631 and is a distinct relationship source.
Original photographic sources and concise paraphrases do not amount to a diplomatic first-edition transcription.
